concepts.name: constraint propagation
concepts.description: A reasoning process that reduces the possible values of variables by enforcing constraints, typically until a unique solution emerges.

concepts.name: variable
concepts.description: An element in the problem space whose value is to be determined.

concepts.name: domain
concepts.description: The set of all possible values a variable can take before constraints are applied.

concepts.name: constraint
concepts.description: A rule that restricts the possible values of variables.

concepts.name: domain reduction
concepts.description: The process of eliminating values from a variable's domain that violate constraints.

concepts.name: consistency
concepts.description: A state in which all constraints are satisfied and no variable has an empty domain.

concepts.name: intersection constraint types
concepts.description: Categories of constraints applied to points where lines meet, such as Y-Constraint, W-Constraint, L-Constraint, and T-Constraint.

concepts.name: edge constraint types
concepts.description: Categories of constraints applied to edges, such as 'fold' or 'blade', determined by the constraints of connected intersections.

concepts.name: grammatical constraint
concepts.description: A rule that determines whether a sentence structure is valid according to grammar, regardless of semantic meaning.
